chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn ʿAbd al-Hamid, from Abu Jamilah al-Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣaliḥ, from Zayd al-Shaḥḥam, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who forgot the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah until he returned to his family, and he said: It is performed on his behalf.

The proper way regarding this report is that we interpret it as applying to one who is unable to return to Makkah; for it is permissible for him to appoint another in his place for that. But whoever is able, nothing is permissible for him except returning, in accordance with what was contained in the first report.

key_terms.الرُّجُوعِ: returning to Makkah to complete the omitted rite
key_terms.السَّعْيَ: the ritual walking between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah in hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, one of the two points between which saʿy is performed
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other point between which saʿy is performed
key_terms.يَسْتَنِيبَ: to appoint or authorize another person as one’s representative
key_terms.يُطَافُ عَنْهُ: it is carried out on his behalf by proxy

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah and returns home?
ai.summary: This report discusses the ruling for someone who forgot the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah until after returning home. It states that the rite may be performed on his behalf, and clarifies that this applies to one unable to return to Makkah, whereas one who is able must personally go back and complete it.
